'''Chapter 211''' is titled "King".

==Cover Page==
[[Hatchan's Sea-Floor Stroll]], Vol. 26: "With Macro's Treasure Too, No Way I'll Fail".

With a bigger haul than he would've ever dreamed—the legendary takoyaki sauce, [[Mash|the perfect meat]], and a heap of [[treasure]] from [[Macro]]'s ship—[[Hatchan]] races off to re-propose to [[Octopako]].

==Short Summary==
With all [[Baroque Works]] agents defeated, [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] and [[Nefertari Cobra|Cobra]] puts an end to the [[Arabasta]] civil war, leaving the mission accomplished for the [[Straw Hat Pirates]].

==Long Summary==
While the rains continues to fall, and despite [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]]'s words, the two armies still continue to distrust each other. However the princess receive helps from 2 of her friends she thought dead. [[Chaka]] appears in front of the royal army and order them to stop while on the rebel's side [[Igaram]], carrying a wounded [[Kappa]], reveals them that the King, who started the up rise by killing innocent people, was [[Bentham|a fake]]. After the truth is revealed, all the weapons are put down and peace finally comes to [[Arabasta]].

Vivi, relieved that Igaram is alive, runs down from the tower searching after her Straw Hats friends, but they have left, searching after their captain. They found him unconscious carried on the back of a beard man. When they are finally rejoined by Vivi, she reveals them that the beard man is none other than her father, the king of Arabasta, who explained to them what happened in the Royal Tomb. The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] then ask Vivi and her father to hurry to the place so that they can conclude formally the battle, when asked to come with her, they decline as being pirates, they can not be given honor.

Once alone, everyone collapses for a well deserved rest.

Meanwhile, [[Tashigi]] the [[Marines]] finds the unconscious [[Crocodile]] and arrest him, and revoke his title of Warlord, for his betrayal against the [[World Government|government]], meanwhile, the rest of the unconscious Baroque Works agents are shown, and presumably arrested, with the excption of Mr. 2. While [[Nefertari Cobra|Cobra]] reassures his people by forgiving the rebels and asking everyone to help him rebuild their country. Arabasta's sorrow has finally ended.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*The rebellion ends.
*[[Nefetari Cobra|Cobra]] carries Luffy out of the crypt back to the other Straw Hats.
**He states Luffy saved [[Nefetari Cobra|two]] [[Nico Robin|people]] from the rubble of the collapsed crypt and Crocodile's poison was neutralized.
*[[Crocodile]]'s title of Warlord is revoked because of his crimes; he and the rest of the [[Baroque Works]] agents are arrested by the [[Marines]]; the exceptions being [[Mr. 2]] (who attempts escape) and [[Nico Robin|Miss All Sunday]] (whose whereabouts are unknown and she is presumed to have been killed).
